extraction.Name: Alvina Turgeon (Ducharme)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded December 5, 1918, but the records do not show by whom
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: The land was mortgaged on December 4, 1918 for $2,000.00; again in 1923 for $3,000.00 and again in 1926 for $4500. The land was sold for tax in 1926, certificate No. 223.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: The land was sold for tax in 1926, certificate No. 223. Subsequent taxes were unpaid March 6, 1929.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612803 issued; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee February 14, 1918; the northeast quarter of section 15, township 96, range 71; the latter mortgage is not due until January 26, 1931
